_about: Hand-kept numbers for the Food trucks page. Permit counts come from news reports quoting state and city health departments; update when DEC or the Anchorage Health Department releases a new count. Census business counts (County Business Patterns, Nonemployer Statistics) are live in site/data/food-trucks.json and are not kept here.
